run_train_baseline: run the baseline DDP training with raw Transformer Engine FP8 autocast and bfloat16 mixed precision
run_train_integration: run the DDP training integration test using Accelerator with FP8RecipeKwargs and mixed precision fp8
test_train_baseline: test the baseline training function that converts a model to Transformer Engine and wraps it in DDP
test_train_integration: test the integration training function that uses Accelerator prepare with FP8 recipe kwargs handlers
run_ddp_benchmark: run the DDP benchmark comparing baseline raw Transformer Engine training against Accelerator FP8 integration training
